rows.title: Berberine induces pleiotropic beneficial effects via hormesis.
rows.focus: Review of berberine’s pleiotropic effects and hormetic dose-response patterns across biomedical models; mechanistic review evidence only, not a basis for consumer dose recommendations.

rows.title: Vitamin-B12 status among the mother-infant dyad: an explorative overview in a single centre in Lombardy.
rows.focus: Retrospective mother-infant cohort showing strong correlation between maternal and neonatal B12 status, with biochemical normalization after supplementation; observational follow-up evidence with newborn-screening context.

rows.title: Association of Vitamin B12 and Folate Deficiency with Vasovagal Syncope: A Case-Control Study.
rows.journal: Research in heart yield and translational medicine
rows.focus: Adult case-control study found no overall association between B12/folate deficiency and vasovagal syncope, though frequent syncope was associated with lower serum B12; observational association only.

rows.title: Iron status from diet and serum in relation to biological aging acceleration: A NHANES cross-sectional study.
rows.journal: Asia Pacific journal of clinical nutrition
rows.focus: NHANES cross-sectional analysis linked dietary, supplemental, and serum iron measures with biological-age metrics; associations are observational and should not be treated as causal or dosing guidance.
